name: benign_workstation
description: Ordinary host content that a naive check mistakes for an intrusion. Nothing here is malicious and NOTHING here should be High. This is the only scenario that asks what the collection said in addition to what it found — every precision defect so far came from a live host, because the other scenarios structurally cannot ask that question. When this one fails, the finding is a false positive with a reproducible cause attached.

plant.content:
# Password rotation runbook
Rotate service credentials quarterly.
Notes on where secrets live and who owns rotation.

expect.id: a bulk archive extraction is NOT read as timestomping
no reverse-shell finding on a host that has none
a webshell is not invented where there is no web content
no GOT/PLT hook is reported on ordinary processes
documents whose NAMES resemble credential stores are not credential theft
the whole benign host stays under a High-finding budget
nothing fires on a benign host that is not declared and understood
collection still happened — this is a benign host, not an empty one
and the timeline was still built
